an9.92:1.1: iddhipādavasena vitthāretabbaṃ.) XCII. Pañc' ime bhikkhave cetaso vinibandhā. Katame pañca? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti . . . pe . . . Ime kho bhikkhave pañca cetaso vinibandhā.
an9.92:2.1: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ cetaso vinibandhānaṃ pahānāya ime cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbā. Katame cattāro? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, viriyasamādhi. . . cittasamādhi- . . . vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ cetaso vinibandhānaṃ pahānāya ime cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbā ti. Iddhipādavaggo navamo.
an9.92:3.1: Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā padhānā caturo pade Cattāro iddhipādā pi purimehi ca yojaye ti.
